lines.say: Welcome to Class 20. Phone Calls, Messages and Appointments.
Rule one. Use polite phone phrases: This is ..., Could I speak to ..., Can I take a message?.

show.text: Use polite phone phrases: This is ..., Could I speak to ..., Can I take a message?.
